messages:
alex: @inc-bot paging: metering-alert token_count_drift severity=high
inc-bot: Incident created INC-2025-0453 — paging @sre-oncall; summary: token delta +6% across us/eu, auto-overage flags firing
sre-oncall: picking up. what's the customer impact?
alex: seeing delayed usage reports + duplicate emits. A few customers already got overage emails. Spike started ~1749501000
maria: consumer lag on metering-ingest (kafka p12) ~120k msgs, emitter-prod shows bursts of replays
jamal: emitter-prod k8s logs show multiple restarts during last deploy window around 1749499800 — suspect duplicate writes on reconnect
sre-oncall: can we mute billing notifications while we triage? support team will panic otherwise
maria: muting billing-notify for customers with tag:affected_metering now :white_check_mark: (rule ID: bill-notify-2025-22)
alex: rolling back emitter-prod eu1 -> previous stable to stop duplicate emits. Deploy command run: 
```
kubectl -n metering rollout undo deployment/emitter-prod --to-revision=3
```
jamal: started consumer offset reset for metering-consumer-group to last-committed checkpoint 
`kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --group metering-consumer --reset-offsets --to-datetime 2025-12-01T02:10:00Z`
sre-oncall: starting a short reconcile/backfill job to dedupe and reconcile counts. Holding customer notifications until recon complete
maria: backfill job queued on backfill-cluster, estimated runtime ~25m for affected window (24h window)
alex: affected footprint: 14 small accounts + 2 mid-market accounts. Some saw temporary overage flags but not yet billed. Recommend credits once reconciled instead of refunds unless customers escalate
jamal: after rollback, emit rate normalized on eu1. Observability: token delta trending down towards baseline (see chart link: https://observability/r/plots/17495)
maria: backfill running — ingest lag decreasing from 120k -> 8k over 10m
sre-oncall: status -> mitigating. Capture timeline and key artifacts in incident doc. Support: please pause any automated billing alerts (support-bot ping)
support-bot: SUPPORT QUEUE notified. Tag HOLD_BILLING_NOTICES applied to affected accounts
alex: action items: 1) finish backfill + validation 2) reconcile publish (do not trigger billing) 3) postmortem + deploy-safety prechecks 4) follow-up customer comms template
maria: will attach deploy logs and kafka offsets to the incident doc once backfill completes
jamal: recommend adding pre-deploy consumer-check that verifies no in-flight restarts; will draft proposal
sre-oncall: I'll own the postmortem and timeline. Assigning to @alex @maria @jamal for technical writeups
maria: will send list of affected accounts + timestamps once backfill confirms final counts
alex: thanks team — nice quick rollback and holding notifications saved a lot of churn :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: good job. closing pager after backfill verification.
inc-bot: Incident INC-2025-0453 status updated -> mitigating (owner: sre-oncall). Next update at 1749501800 or earlier.
alex: noted. closing thread after validation and customer comms plan finalized :heart:
